practiceReport.name: Josh Jacobs
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Officially ruled Out on weekly game status report
practiceReport.beatComment: With the Packers playing Wednesday against the Rams, the team posted an official practice report Sunday, and Jacobs was one of nine players deemed limited in the session. While it's encouraging that the running back was able to get some work in Sunday, Wes Hodkiewicz of the team's official site noted earlier Sunday that coach Matt LaFleur indicated Jacobs will "have to show a lot of progress" over the next couple days to be available versus Los Angeles. If Jacobs remains out Wednesday, Kaleb Johnson, MarShawn Lloyd and Chris Brooks would be in line to handle Green Bay's backfield duties in his absence.

practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (9th NFL season, 99% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Officially ruled Out on weekly game status report
practiceReport.beatComment: A shin injury has prevented Franklin from playing in each of the Packers' last four games. A full practice over the next two days would probably be enough for him to return for Week 12 against the Rams on Wednesday.

practiceReport.name: Sean Rhyan
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (87% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Officially ruled Out on weekly game status report
practiceReport.beatComment: Rhyan suffered an ankle injury against Detroit in Week 7 and hasn't played since. In fact, he hadn't practiced in any capacity until his limited session Sunday. Rhyan's ability to get in some reps suggests that he's progressing in his recovery, though it remains to be seen if he'll be able to return to action Wednesday versus the Rams.

practiceReport.name: Micah Parsons
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Explosive pass rusher who regularly manages mid-week reps and plays high-leverage third-down snaps.
factors: 21-day IR practice window open (Week 3); awaiting current-week practice ramp
Requires formal 53-man roster activation prior to weekly NFL transaction deadline
practiceReport.beatComment: For a third week in a row, Parsons has maintained limited listings on Packers injury reports as he strives for his first game action since Dec. 14, 2025, when he tore the ACL in his left knee. Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported earlier Sunday that Parsons is "on track" to return to action Wednesday versus the Rams, but first Green Bay will need to activate him from the reserve/PUP list for him to have a chance to do so.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Luke Musgrave
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: LaFleur acknowledged that Musgrove is still in the process of rehabbing the neck injury he sustained during OTAs in June, and the Packers haven't yet prepared for the tight end to resume practicing. Barring dramatic progress in his recovery over the next month, Musgrave looks like he'll be sidelined for the final season of his rookie deal before hitting free agency in the spring.
